content:
Apple TV keeps adding new batches of classic movies to kick off each month, with 13 fresh films available free for subscribers today. Here’s everything new.

Apple TV adds 13 popular classic movies, all available free for subscribers

For nearly seven years since Apple TV launched, the service has almost exclusively offered original content. But in the last few months, Apple has added to its library with monthly drops of popular classic movies.

Today, Apple has added 13 new movies that are available free for subscribers. They join several holdovers from past months.

Here’s everything new this month:

  • American Gangster
  • Good Will Hunting
  • Insomnia
  • 28 Days Later
  • Taxi Driver
  • Jurassic World
  • Black Hawk Down
  • Going the Distance
  • Fury
  • Tropic Thunder
  • The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
  • Fallen
  • Blood Diamond

Other films still available that were added in the last couple months include The Sixth Sense, Master and Commander, The Rookie, and more.

If you live outside the US, the new titles available can vary as Apple has different rights deals elsewhere.

For more new releases coming to Apple TV soon, see our overview of October premieres here.

Which classic movies on Apple TV will you add to your queue? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $14.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
